dashboard.label: License
dashboard.description: Enter the BentleyPC license key for TA-IPMI and review hourly usage beacon status. Evaluation, personal and lab use is free; commercial use requires a license. Alternatively write the key directly to local/license.conf inside the app directory (no restart needed).

panel.title: License setup and status — click any row to open the key entry page

search.query: | makeresults | eval host="OPEN LICENSE SETUP PAGE", status="Paste your BP- key from bentleypc.com/TA-IPMI", last_reported="hourly beacon sends only: key, hostname, app, version", note="Buy or trial a license at bentleypc.com/TA-IPMI" | fields host status last_reported note | append [ search index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" source="ta_license:TA-IPMI" earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M") | fields host status last_reported note ] | sort host
